mālatī = identity disputed (possibly a jasmine); mark '(identity disputed)' in both languages. palala = identity disputed (possibly sesame paste), never 'probable'.

Hindi reusable: शालिपर्णी यानी सरिवन, पलाश यानी सम्भवतः ढाक, अग्निमन्थ यानी सम्भवतः अरणी, पाटली यानी पाढ़ल, करवीर यानी कनेर, बदर यानी बेर, नवनीत यानी मक्खन, पिचु यानी रुई का फाहा, मस्तु यानी दही का पानी.
puṃnāma-phala = 'male-named fruit' (unidentified), not 'a fruit called punnāma'.
nyubja = face down (prone), not 'bent over'. jñāti (kinsman) = ज्ञाति/सम्बन्धी, not जाति.
Month ordinals standing for an unstated noun: gram 'loc. sg.' (no gender). kathita for water boiled with gold/silver = probable misprint for kvathita (flag it).
